questions.stem: Which is LEAST likely a reason the balance sheet does not measure the market value of equity?

choices.A: Some items are measured at historical cost and others at fair value
choices.B: Fair-value items reflect values at the balance sheet date only
choices.C: Equity is calculated as assets minus liabilities

questions.explanation: Least-likely → T/F each. Mixed measurement (T reason) and point-in-time values (T reason). A − L = E is just the DEFINITION of book equity — it explains nothing about why book differs from market (F → answer). The third real reason: value depends on future cash flows and unrecorded items like reputation.
questions.kr: least likely → T/F. 혼합 측정(T), 시점 가치(T). A − L = E는 장부자본의 '정의'일 뿐 장부≠시장의 이유가 아님(F → 정답). 세 번째 진짜 이유: 미래 현금흐름·평판 등 기록되지 않는 항목.

questions.stem: An item is recognized on the balance sheet only if a future economic benefit is probable AND:

choices.A: it will be held for more than one year
choices.B: its cost or value can be measured reliably
choices.C: it is measured at fair value

questions.explanation: Two conditions: (1) probable flow of future benefit to/from the entity; (2) cost or value measurable with RELIABILITY.
questions.kr: 두 조건: (1) 미래 경제적 효익의 유입/유출 가능성 높음, (2) 원가·가치를 '신뢰성 있게' 측정 가능.

questions.stem: Under IFRS, a company may omit the current/non-current classification if:

choices.A: it also reports under US GAAP
choices.B: a liquidity-based presentation provides reliable and more relevant information
choices.C: its total assets exceed a size threshold

questions.explanation: IFRS exception: liquidity-based presentation when it is RELIABLE AND MORE RELEVANT — typically banks. US GAAP has no such exception in this reading.
questions.kr: IFRS 예외: 유동성 순서 표시가 '신뢰성 있고 더 목적적합'할 때 — 주로 은행.

questions.stem: Apple's occasional 53-week fiscal year is most relevant to the analysis of its:

choices.B: income statement and cash flow statement

questions.explanation: An extra week adds a week of revenue, expense and cash flow — PERIOD statements. The balance sheet is a point-in-time snapshot (and C is just its other name).
questions.kr: 1주 추가 → 수익·비용·현금흐름(기간 재무제표)에 영향. 재무상태표는 시점 스냅샷(C는 같은 표의 다른 이름).

questions.stem: The liquidity of an individual asset refers to:

choices.B: its nearness to cash at a price close to fair market value
choices.C: whether it is classified as current

questions.explanation: Asset liquidity = 'nearness to cash' — convertible quickly at a price close to fair value (actively traded stock vs commercial real estate).
questions.kr: 자산 유동성 = '현금 근접성' — 공정가치에 가까운 가격으로 빠르게 현금화 가능.

questions.stem: A distillery holds whisky for three years before sale; its operating cycle is three years. The inventory is most likely classified as:

choices.A: non-current, since it is held longer than one year
choices.B: current, since it will be sold within one operating cycle
choices.C: non-current, since the operating cycle exceeds one year

questions.explanation: Current = one year OR one operating cycle, WHICHEVER IS GREATER. The cycle is three years, so inventory sold within it is current.
questions.kr: 유동 = 1년 또는 영업주기 중 '긴 쪽'. 영업주기 3년 → 그 안에 판매될 재고는 유동.

questions.stem: An asset is current if it is expected to be realized within one year or one operating cycle:

choices.B: whichever is greater

questions.explanation: The rule is 'whichever is GREATER' — that is what keeps long-cycle inventory (tobacco, lumber, whisky) current.
questions.kr: 규칙은 '긴 쪽' — 그래서 장기 영업주기 재고(담배·목재·위스키)도 유동.

questions.stem: A loan is due in 18 months, but the lender may demand repayment at any time. The liability is most likely:

choices.A: non-current, since it is due beyond one year
choices.B: current, since the entity has no unconditional right to defer settlement for at least one year
choices.C: non-current, since it is not held for trading

questions.explanation: Criterion 4: no UNCONDITIONAL right to defer settlement ≥ 1 year → current, regardless of the scheduled maturity. Any one of the four criteria suffices.
questions.kr: 기준 4: 1년 이상 결제를 연기할 '무조건적 권리'가 없음 → 유동. 네 기준 중 하나만 충족해도 됨.

questions.stem: Current assets 420; current liabilities 310; non-current liabilities 500. Working capital is closest to:
questions.explanation: Working capital = CA − CL = 420 − 310 = 110. Non-current liabilities are not in the formula — they are the distractor (B subtracts all liabilities).
questions.kr: 운전자본 = 유동자산 − 유동부채 = 110. 비유동부채는 공식에 없음(B는 전체 부채를 뺌).

questions.stem: Excessive working capital is undesirable mainly because it:

choices.B: ties up funds that could be used more productively

questions.explanation: Adequate working capital is essential; EXCESSIVE working capital leaves funds idle that could be used more productively elsewhere.
questions.kr: 적정 운전자본은 필수, '과도한' 운전자본은 더 생산적으로 쓸 수 있는 자금을 묶어 둠.

questions.stem: Under IFRS, trade payables to be settled more than one year after the balance sheet date are most likely classified as:

choices.B: current, since they are part of the normal operating cycle

questions.explanation: IFRS: trade payables and operating accruals are part of working capital in the normal operating cycle → current even if settled more than 12 months out.
questions.kr: IFRS: 매입채무·영업 관련 미지급비용은 정상영업주기의 운전자본 → 12개월 넘게 결제돼도 유동.

questions.stem: A balance sheet listing all assets from cash through goodwill in order of liquidity, with no current/non-current subtotals, is best described as:

choices.B: a liquidity-based presentation

questions.explanation: No current/non-current subtotals + liquidity ordering = liquidity-based presentation (HSBC). A classified balance sheet HAS those subtotals.
questions.kr: 유동/비유동 소계 없음 + 유동성 순서 = 유동성 순서 표시(HSBC). 구분 재무상태표는 소계가 있음.

questions.stem: Entities most likely to use a liquidity-based presentation are:

choices.B: banks

questions.explanation: Banks — balance sheets dominated by financial instruments, where liquidity ordering is more relevant than the current/non-current split.
questions.kr: 은행 — 금융상품 위주라 유동성 순서가 더 목적적합.

questions.stem: A company reports net receivables of 2,400 after an allowance for doubtful accounts of 60. The percentage of gross receivables estimated to be uncollectible is closest to:
questions.explanation: Gross = net + allowance = 2,460. 60 / 2,460 = 2.44%. Choice A divides by the NET figure (60/2,400). Add the allowance back first.
questions.kr: 총채권 = 순채권 + 충당금 = 2,460. 60/2,460 = 2.44%. A는 '순'채권으로 나눔. 충당금을 먼저 더하기.

questions.stem: When a specific receivable is written off as uncollectible, the most likely effect is that:

choices.B: net receivables are unchanged

questions.explanation: Write-off: allowance ↓ and gross receivables ↓ by the same amount → net unchanged; NO income-statement effect (the expense was recognized when the allowance was built).
questions.kr: 대손 확정(제각): 충당금 ↓, 총채권 ↓ 같은 금액 → 순채권 불변, 손익 영향 없음(비용은 충당금 설정 때 이미 인식).

questions.stem: The allowance for doubtful accounts is best described as:

choices.B: a contra account netted against accounts receivable

questions.explanation: A CONTRA-ASSET: it reduces gross receivables to net realizable value. Bad-debt EXPENSE is the income-statement account.
questions.kr: 차감 계정(contra-asset): 총채권을 순실현가능가치로 줄임. 대손'비용'은 손익계산서 계정.

questions.stem: Which is LEAST likely a cash equivalent?

choices.A: A Treasury bill with two months to maturity
choices.B: A money market fund
choices.C: Cash restricted in use for 18 months

questions.explanation: Least-likely → T/F. T-bill ≤ 3 months (T), money market fund (T). Cash restricted for ≥ 12 months is EXCLUDED (F → answer).
questions.kr: least likely → T/F. 만기 3개월 이하 T-bill(T), MMF(T). 12개월 이상 사용 제한 현금은 '제외'(F → 정답).

questions.stem: Management seeking to increase reported income this period would most likely:

choices.B: under-estimate collectability of receivables

questions.explanation: Over-estimating collectability → smaller allowance → lower bad-debt expense → HIGHER net income. A and B both RAISE expense (that's the good-year cushion move).
questions.kr: 회수가능성 과대추정 → 충당금 ↓ → 대손비용 ↓ → 순이익 '증가'. A·B는 비용을 늘림(호황기 쿠션 쌓기).

questions.stem: No customer accounts for 10% of a company's revenue, yet two customers each account for over 10% of its trade receivables. This best illustrates that:

choices.A: revenue concentration and receivables concentration are different measures
choices.B: the allowance is understated

questions.explanation: Concentration can be low on revenue and high on receivables at the same time (Apple). They measure different exposures.
questions.kr: 매출 집중도는 낮고 채권 집중도는 높을 수 있음(Apple). 서로 다른 지표.

questions.stem: A significant increase in receivables relative to sales most likely signals:

choices.B: problems collecting cash from customers

questions.explanation: Receivables growing faster than sales → cash isn't being collected as quickly → potential collection problems.
questions.kr: 매출보다 채권이 빠르게 증가 → 현금 회수 지연 → 회수 문제 가능성.

questions.stem: Under IFRS, inventories are measured at:

choices.A: the lower of cost or market
choices.B: the lower of cost and net realizable value

questions.explanation: IFRS: lower of cost and NRV — for ALL inventories. 'Lower of cost or market' is the US GAAP phrase for LIFO/retail only.
questions.kr: IFRS: 원가와 순실현가능가치 중 낮은 금액 — '모든' 재고. 'cost or market'은 US GAAP의 LIFO/소매 전용 표현.

questions.stem: Reversal of a prior inventory write-down after the value recovers is:

choices.A: permitted under both IFRS and US GAAP
choices.B: permitted under IFRS but not US GAAP
choices.C: permitted under US GAAP but not IFRS

questions.explanation: IFRS permits reversal (capped at the original write-down); US GAAP prohibits it. The same split applies to PP&E impairment.
questions.kr: IFRS 환입 허용(원래 감액 한도), US GAAP 금지. 유형자산 손상차손 환입도 같은 구분.

questions.stem: Which inventory cost formula is NOT permitted under IFRS?

choices.B: First-in, first-out

questions.explanation: IFRS permits FIFO, weighted average and specific identification. LIFO is prohibited under IFRS (allowed under US GAAP).
questions.kr: IFRS 허용: FIFO·가중평균·개별법. LIFO는 IFRS 금지(US GAAP 허용).

questions.stem: Under US GAAP, for LIFO inventory, 'market' is best described as:

choices.B: current replacement cost, bounded above by NRV and below by NRV less a normal profit margin
choices.C: fair value less costs to sell

questions.explanation: Market = REPLACEMENT COST with a ceiling (NRV) and a floor (NRV − normal profit margin). Not fair value.
questions.kr: 시가 = '현행 대체원가', 상한 NRV, 하한 NRV − 정상이익. 공정가치 아님.

questions.stem: Net realizable value is best described as estimated selling price:

choices.A: less estimated costs of completion and costs to make the sale
choices.B: less a normal profit margin

questions.explanation: NRV = selling price − costs to complete − costs to sell. Choice B describes the US GAAP market FLOOR.
questions.kr: NRV = 판매가 − 완성원가 − 판매비용. B는 US GAAP 시가의 '하한'.

questions.stem: A company pays a full year's insurance premium on 31 December. At that date it most likely:

choices.A: recognizes the full amount as an expense
choices.B: recognizes an asset, expensed one-twelfth per month

questions.explanation: Expenses are recognized when incurred, not when paid → the prepayment is an ASSET (prepaid insurance), expensed 1/12 per month as it is used up.
questions.kr: 비용은 지급 시점이 아니라 발생 시점에 인식 → 선급금은 '자산'(선급보험료), 매월 1/12씩 비용화.

questions.stem: Under IFRS, the reversal of an inventory write-down is limited to:

choices.A: the amount of the original write-down
choices.B: net realizable value at the reversal date

questions.explanation: IFRS allows reversal only up to the amount of the ORIGINAL write-down — carrying value can't rise above the pre-write-down cost basis.
questions.kr: IFRS 환입은 '원래 감액액'까지만.

questions.stem: The portion of a 10-year bond maturing within the next 12 months is most likely classified as:

choices.B: a current liability

questions.explanation: The current portion of long-term debt is a CURRENT liability (financial liabilities include it).
questions.kr: 장기부채의 유동성 대체분 = '유동'부채.

questions.stem: A company receives 500 in cash on the first day of a two-year service contract. At that date it most likely records:

choices.B: a liability of 500
choices.C: revenue of 250 and a liability of 250

questions.explanation: Cash before delivery → deferred revenue (a LIABILITY) of the full 500. Revenue is recognized as the service is delivered over two years — none on day one.
questions.kr: 인도 전 현금 → 전액 500 선수수익('부채'). 2년에 걸쳐 수익 인식 — 첫날은 0.

questions.stem: For liquidity analysis, settling deferred revenue differs from settling accounts payable in that it:

choices.B: does not require a cash outflow

questions.explanation: Deferred revenue is settled by DELIVERING the service — cash was already received. Accounts payable requires paying cash to suppliers.
questions.kr: 선수수익은 서비스 '제공'으로 상환 — 현금은 이미 받음. 매입채무는 현금 지급 필요.

questions.stem: Investors monitor deferred revenue because growth in it most likely implies:

choices.B: future growth in revenue

questions.explanation: Deferred revenue becomes revenue as it is earned → growth in it signals future revenue growth.
questions.kr: 선수수익은 나중에 수익이 됨 → 증가는 미래 수익 성장 신호.

questions.stem: Accrued expenses are best described as expenses that have been:

choices.B: recognized on the income statement but not yet paid

questions.explanation: Accrued = recognized (expensed) but not yet paid. 'Paid but not yet recognized' is a PREPAID expense (an asset).
questions.kr: 미지급비용 = 인식(비용 처리)했지만 미지급. '지급했지만 미인식'은 선급비용(자산).

questions.stem: A company pays income tax on cash received for revenue not yet recognized for accounting purposes. The tax paid most likely creates:

choices.B: a deferred tax asset

questions.explanation: Tax paid BEFORE the related book tax expense → taxes payable > tax expense → DTA ('prepaid taxes').
questions.kr: 장부상 법인세비용 '이전'에 세금 납부 → 납부세액 > 법인세비용 → 이연법인세자산('선급 세금').

questions.stem: Trade credit is best described as:

choices.A: credit a company extends to its customers
choices.B: credit provided to a company by its vendors
choices.C: a bank loan for trade finance

questions.explanation: Trade credit = credit from VENDORS (it shows up as trade payables) — a source of financing. Credit to customers shows up as receivables.
questions.kr: 매입신용 = '공급자'가 제공하는 신용(매입채무) — 자금조달원. 고객에게 준 신용은 매출채권.

questions.stem: An asset has a carrying amount of 800, fair value less costs to sell of 650, and value in use of 720. Under IFRS the impairment loss is closest to:
questions.explanation: Recoverable = HIGHER of 650 and 720 = 720. Loss = 800 − 720 = 80. Choice A uses the lower (650).
questions.kr: 회수가능액 = 650과 720 중 '큰' 값 = 720. 손상차손 = 800 − 720 = 80. A는 작은 값 사용.

questions.stem: Under IFRS, the recoverable amount of an asset is:

choices.A: the lower of fair value less costs to sell and value in use
choices.B: the higher of fair value less costs to sell and value in use

questions.explanation: Recoverable = HIGHER — the asset is worth the better of selling it or using it.
questions.kr: 회수가능액 = '큰' 값 — 팔거나 쓰는 것 중 더 나은 쪽.

questions.stem: Reversal of a previously recognized impairment loss on PP&E is:

choices.A: permitted under IFRS but not US GAAP
choices.B: permitted under US GAAP but not IFRS

questions.explanation: IFRS permits impairment reversal; US GAAP does not — the same split as inventory write-downs.
questions.kr: IFRS 손상차손 환입 허용, US GAAP 금지 — 재고 감액과 같은 구분.

questions.stem: Under IFRS, a company using the revaluation model for PP&E must:

choices.B: apply the same model to all assets within a class

questions.explanation: Models can differ BETWEEN classes, but must be the same WITHIN a class.
questions.kr: 모형은 분류 '간'에는 달라도 되지만 분류 '내'에서는 동일해야 함.

questions.stem: Under IFRS, a gain from an increase in the fair value of investment property under the fair value model is recognized in:

choices.B: profit or loss

questions.explanation: Investment property fair value model → changes go to PROFIT OR LOSS. Don't carry over the PP&E revaluation idea (equity/OCI).
questions.kr: 투자부동산 공정가치모형 → 변동은 '당기손익'. 유형자산 재평가(자본/OCI)와 혼동 금지.

questions.stem: Which is NOT available under US GAAP?

choices.B: The revaluation model for PP&E

questions.explanation: US GAAP: cost model only. The revaluation model is IFRS-only.
questions.kr: US GAAP: 원가모형만. 재평가모형은 IFRS 전용.

questions.stem: Value in use is best described as:

choices.A: the price obtainable in an arm's-length sale
choices.B: the present value of the asset's expected future cash flows

questions.explanation: Value in use = PV of future cash flows from using the asset. Choice A is fair value (less costs to sell).
questions.kr: 사용가치 = 자산 사용으로 기대되는 미래 현금흐름의 현재가치. A는 공정가치(처분부대원가 차감).

questions.stem: A deferred tax asset most likely arises when, due to a temporary difference:

choices.A: income tax expense exceeds income tax payable
choices.B: income tax payable exceeds income tax expense
choices.C: book pre-tax income exceeds taxable income

questions.explanation: DTA: taxes PAYABLE > tax EXPENSE (taxable income > book income). Choices A and C describe the reverse — a deferred tax LIABILITY.
questions.kr: 이연법인세자산: 납부세액 > 법인세비용(과세소득 > 회계이익). A·C는 반대 — 이연법인세'부채'.

questions.stem: A company recognizes warranty expense this year in its financial statements but can deduct it for tax only when claims are paid later. This year it most likely records:

choices.B: a deferred tax asset

questions.explanation: Expense booked now, deductible later → book income < taxable income → taxes payable > expense → DTA.
questions.kr: 지금 비용 인식, 세무상 공제는 나중 → 회계이익 < 과세소득 → 납부세액 > 비용 → 이연법인세자산.

questions.stem: A deferred tax asset should be recognized only if:

choices.A: the difference will reverse within one year
choices.B: future taxable income is expected against which it can be applied
choices.C: the company has an equal deferred tax liability

questions.explanation: No expected future taxable income → the benefit can never be used → no asset.
questions.kr: 미래 과세소득이 예상되지 않으면 효익을 쓸 수 없음 → 자산 아님.

questions.stem: Which gives rise to a deferred tax asset but is NOT a temporary timing difference?

choices.A: Revenue taxed before it is recognized for accounting
choices.B: An unused tax loss carried forward
choices.C: An expense deducted for accounting before tax

questions.explanation: Loss/credit carryforwards create DTAs (they reduce future taxes) but are a separate source, not timing differences. A and C are the two timing routes.
questions.kr: 결손금·세액공제 이월은 이연법인세자산을 만들지만 일시적 차이가 아닌 별도 원천. A·C는 두 가지 일시적 차이 경로.

questions.stem: A company has 10 million shares authorized, 8 million issued, and 1.5 million held in treasury. Shares outstanding are closest to:

choices.B: 8.0 million

questions.explanation: Outstanding = issued − treasury = 8.0 − 1.5 = 6.5m. Authorized is irrelevant. Treasury shares are issued but not outstanding.
questions.kr: 유통주식 = 발행 − 자기주식 = 6.5m. 수권주식은 무관. 자기주식은 발행됐지만 유통 아님.

questions.stem: Preferred shares with mandatory redemption at a fixed amount on a fixed date are most likely classified as:

choices.B: a financial liability

questions.explanation: Classified by SUBSTANCE: a fixed obligation to pay cash on a fixed date is a liability. Perpetual, non-redeemable preferred is equity.
questions.kr: '실질'로 분류: 정해진 날 정해진 금액 상환 의무 → 부채. 영구·비상환 우선주는 자본.

questions.stem: When a company reissues treasury shares above their repurchase cost, it most likely:

choices.A: recognizes a gain on the income statement
choices.B: recognizes no gain or loss on the income statement

questions.explanation: Transactions in a company's own shares are owner transactions — NO gain or loss is recognized on the income statement.
questions.kr: 자기주식 거래는 주주와의 거래 — 손익계산서에 손익 인식 없음.

questions.stem: Which is LEAST likely a component of equity attributable to the owners of the parent?

choices.B: Non-controlling interest

questions.explanation: C-P-T-R-A-N: the first five belong to the parent's owners; NCI belongs to minority shareholders of subsidiaries.
questions.kr: C-P-T-R-A-N: 앞 다섯은 지배주주 귀속, 비지배지분은 종속회사 소수주주 몫.

questions.stem: A repurchase of shares held as treasury stock most likely:

choices.B: reduces shareholders' equity by the cost of the repurchase
choices.C: has no effect on shares outstanding

questions.explanation: Treasury purchase → equity ↓ by the COST and shares outstanding ↓.
questions.kr: 자기주식 취득 → 자본이 '원가'만큼 감소, 유통주식 감소.

questions.stem: The cumulative amount of other comprehensive income is reported in:

choices.B: accumulated other comprehensive income

questions.explanation: NI accumulates in retained earnings; OCI accumulates in AOCI.
questions.kr: 순이익은 이익잉여금, OCI는 기타포괄손익누계액(AOCI)에 누적.

questions.stem: Under IFRS, the statement of changes in equity is LEAST likely required to show:

choices.A: total comprehensive income for the period
choices.B: the effects of accounting changes applied retrospectively
choices.C: a reconciliation of total assets from beginning to end of the period

questions.explanation: C-R-O-R: comprehensive income, retrospective changes, owner transactions, reconciliation of each EQUITY component. Total assets are not reconciled here.
questions.kr: C-R-O-R: 포괄이익, 소급 변경, 주주거래, '자본 구성요소별' 조정. 총자산 조정은 아님.

questions.stem: A cash dividend declared during the period is most likely shown in the statement of changes in equity as:

choices.B: a deduction from retained earnings

questions.explanation: Dividends are a DISTRIBUTION to owners — deducted from retained earnings, never an expense.
questions.kr: 배당은 주주에 대한 '분배' — 이익잉여금에서 차감, 비용 아님.

questions.stem: Beginning equity 500; net income 80; dividends 20; shares repurchased 30; share-based compensation 10; ending equity 545. OCI for the period is closest to:
questions.explanation: Expected end = 500 + 80 − 20 − 30 + 10 = 540. OCI = 545 − 540 = +5. Choice B stops after net income (545 − 500 − 80). Fill every slot before taking the residual.

questions.stem: A company that cancels repurchased shares rather than holding them in treasury will most likely show the repurchase as:

choices.A: a reduction in retained earnings and/or paid-in capital
choices.B: an increase in treasury stock

questions.explanation: Cancelled shares → no treasury line; the cost is charged against retained earnings and/or paid-in capital (Apple charged RE).
questions.kr: 소각 → 자기주식 계정 없음; 원가를 이익잉여금 및/또는 납입자본에서 차감(Apple은 이익잉여금).

questions.stem: An unrealized loss on available-for-sale securities is most likely shown in the statement of changes in equity as a decrease in:

choices.B: accumulated other comprehensive income

questions.explanation: AFS unrealized gains/losses are OCI → AOCI column, not retained earnings.
questions.kr: 매도가능증권 미실현손익 = OCI → AOCI 열, 이익잉여금 아님.

questions.stem: A company issued 36.5 million shares to employees yet reported a $1.5bn decrease in equity from the transaction. This is best explained by:

choices.A: the shares were issued below par
choices.B: shares were withheld to settle employees' tax obligations and the cash was paid out

questions.explanation: Net settlement: the company withheld shares to cover employees' taxes and paid that cash to the tax authority — cash left the company, so equity fell even though the share count rose.
questions.kr: 순결제: 직원 세금을 위해 주식을 원천징수하고 그 현금을 납부 — 현금 유출로 주식 수는 늘어도 자본은 감소.

questions.stem: Resources a company controls as a result of past events, expected to bring future economic benefits, are:

choices.B: assets

questions.explanation: Asset = resource CONTROLLED from past events, benefits flow TO the entity. Liability = obligation, outflow FROM the entity. Equity = the residual.
questions.kr: 자산 = 과거 사건의 결과로 '통제'하는 자원, 효익 유입. 부채 = 의무·유출. 자본 = 잔여.

questions.stem: Equity is equal to:

choices.B: liabilities minus assets

questions.explanation: A = L + E → E = A − L (the residual claim).
questions.kr: A = L + E → E = A − L(잔여청구권).

questions.stem: A balance sheet that separates current from non-current items and shows subtotals for current assets and current liabilities is called:

choices.B: an unclassified balance sheet

questions.explanation: CLASSIFIED = current/non-current split WITH current subtotals. LIQUIDITY-BASED = all items in order of liquidity with NO current/non-current subtotals (banks). The subtotal is the discriminator.
questions.kr: '구분' 재무상태표 = 유동/비유동 구분 + 유동 소계. '유동성 순서' = 소계 없이 유동성 순서로 나열(은행). 소계 유무가 판별 기준.

questions.concept: Official Q4 — book vs market equity
questions.stem: Book equity most likely differs from the market value of equity because:

choices.A: all assets and liabilities are carried at historical cost
choices.B: some factors that drive future cash flows are not on the balance sheet

questions.explanation: Reputation and management skill drive future cash flows but are not recognized. A is false (the model is MIXED — some items at fair value); C is false (MARKET value updates continuously; book value only at period end).
questions.kr: 평판·경영 능력은 미래 현금흐름을 만들지만 인식되지 않음. A 거짓(혼합 측정), C 거짓(연속 갱신되는 건 '시장'가치, 장부가는 기말 기준).

questions.stem: Which is most likely classified as a current liability?

choices.A: Cash received for a product to be delivered more than one year after the balance sheet date
choices.B: Amounts owed for merchandise, due more than one year out but within the normal operating cycle
choices.C: Debt due in six months that the company has an unconditional right to defer for at least one year

questions.explanation: Operating-cycle items are current even beyond 12 months. A: delivery obligation > 1 year → non-current (deferred revenue). C: an unconditional right to defer ≥ 1 year → non-current despite the six-month date.
questions.kr: 영업주기 내 항목은 12개월이 넘어도 유동. A: 1년 이후 인도 의무 → 비유동 선수수익. C: 1년 이상 연기할 무조건적 권리 → 6개월 만기여도 비유동.

questions.stem: Which entity is most likely to present its balance sheet in order of liquidity?

choices.B: A computer manufacturer with inventories
choices.C: A software company with trade receivables and payables

questions.explanation: Liquidity-based presentation is used by entities like BANKS, where ordering by liquidity is reliable and more relevant. Receivables and payables are ordinary working-capital items — a software company presents a normal classified balance sheet.
questions.kr: 유동성 순서 표시는 '은행' 같은 기관이 사용. 매출채권·매입채무는 평범한 운전자본 항목 — 소프트웨어 회사는 일반 구분 재무상태표.

questions.concept: Official Q7 — debt due within a year
questions.stem: Debt due within one year is classified as:

choices.B: preferred

questions.explanation: Liabilities (including debt) due within one year are CURRENT. Preferred is a class of stock; convertible is a feature of bonds or preferred.
questions.kr: 1년 이내 만기 부채 = '유동'. 우선주는 주식 종류, 전환은 채권·우선주의 특성.

questions.stem: Cash received from customers for products to be delivered later is recorded as:

choices.B: an asset and a liability

questions.explanation: Cash (asset ↑) and unearned/deferred revenue (liability ↑). Revenue is recognized only as the product is delivered, reducing the liability.
questions.kr: 현금(자산 ↑)과 선수수익(부채 ↑). 수익은 인도 시점에 인식하며 부채가 감소.

questions.stem: Which is an example of a contra asset account?

choices.B: Sales returns and allowances

questions.explanation: A contra ASSET reduces an asset's balance: the allowance reduces receivables. Depreciation EXPENSE is an income-statement account — the contra asset is ACCUMULATED depreciation. Sales returns and allowances is a contra-REVENUE account.
questions.kr: 차감 '자산' 계정은 자산 잔액을 줄임: 대손충당금 → 매출채권 차감. 감가상각'비용'은 손익계정 — 차감자산은 '감가상각누계액'. 매출환입·에누리는 '수익' 차감 계정.

questions.front: Current asset rule, the four current-liability criteria, the IFRS operating-payables rule, working capital
questions.back:
CURRENT ASSET: trading, or realized within 1 year OR operating cycle, WHICHEVER IS GREATER (whisky/tobacco/lumber inventory still current; assume 1 yr if cycle unclear).
CURRENT LIABILITY (any one): settled in operating CYCLE | held for TRADING | due within ONE YEAR | NO unconditional right to DEFER ≥ 1 yr.
IFRS: trade payables/operating accruals current even if > 1 yr.
Working capital = CA − CL (not total liabilities); excessive = idle funds.
IFRS exception: liquidity-based presentation (banks) if reliable and more relevant.

questions.front: Gross-up formula, estimate vs write-off, what lowers the allowance, manipulation direction
questions.back:
% uncollectible = allowance / GROSS; gross = net + allowance (58 / 17,932 = 0.32%).
Estimate: bad-debt expense ↑, allowance ↑. Write-off: allowance ↓, gross A/R ↓ — NO IS effect, net unchanged.
Allowance ↓: fewer credit sales (absolute); better credit quality, stricter policy, more insurance (%).
Over-estimate collectability → lower expense → HIGHER NI.
Cash equivalents: original maturity ≤ 3 months; restricted ≥ 12 months excluded.

questions.front: IFRS vs US GAAP inventory: basis, market, reversal, cost formulas; NRV
questions.back:
IFRS: lower of cost and NRV for ALL; reversal PERMITTED (up to original write-down); FIFO / weighted average / specific ID — NO LIFO.
US GAAP: lower of cost and NRV, EXCEPT LIFO/retail → lower of cost or MARKET; market = replacement cost, ceiling NRV, floor NRV − normal margin; reversal NOT permitted; LIFO allowed.
NRV = selling price − costs to complete − costs to sell.
Prepaid expense = ASSET until used.

questions.front: Trade payables, financial liabilities, accrued expenses, deferred revenue — and Example 2
questions.back:
Trade payables = owed to vendors (trade credit = vendor financing).
Financial liabilities = bank loans, notes, commercial paper + current portion of LTD.
Accrued = recognized but NOT yet paid.
Deferred revenue = cash before delivery → LIABILITY; settled by delivering (no cash outflow, unlike A/P); growth ⇒ future revenue.
Ex 2: cash +100, deferred revenue +100; tax 30 paid → cash −30, DTA +30.

questions.front: Cost vs revaluation, the impairment test, reversal, investment property
questions.back:
Cost model (both) vs revaluation (IFRS only; same model within a class; changes → equity or P&L depending).
Impaired if carrying > RECOVERABLE = HIGHER of (fair value − costs to sell) and (value in use = PV of CFs). Loss = carrying − recoverable → IS. Reversal: IFRS yes, US GAAP no.
Investment property (IFRS only): cost or FAIR VALUE (all); FV changes → P&L.

questions.front: When a DTA arises, the routes, the recognition condition
questions.back:
DTA when taxes PAYABLE > tax EXPENSE (taxable income > book income) — temporary differences.
Routes: income taxed now/booked later (deferred revenue); expense booked now/deductible later (warranty). Plus loss/credit carryforwards (NOT timing).
Recognize only if future taxable income is expected.
Reverse (payable < expense) = deferred tax LIABILITY.

questions.front: C-P-T-R-A-N, share counts, preferred, treasury rules, C-R-O-R, the roll-forward
questions.back:
Six: Contributed capital | Preferred | Treasury | Retained earnings | AOCI | NCI (first five = parent).
Outstanding = issued − treasury ≤ issued ≤ authorized.
Mandatory-redeemable preferred = LIABILITY; perpetual = equity.
Treasury: equity ↓ by cost; no gain/loss on reissue; no vote; no dividends. Cancelled (Apple) → no treasury line.
SoCE IFRS: Comprehensive income | Retrospective changes | Owner transactions | Reconciliation per component.
End = Begin + NI ± OCI − dividends − repurchases + issuance/SBC. NI → RE; OCI → AOCI; dividends → RE ↓.
